description: List the individual Canvas users who have a reservation in this appointment group, returning each as a user object (id, name). Only meaningful when the group's participant_type is "User" — a Group-type group returns an empty list here; use list_appointment_group_groups instead for those. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Find the appointment_group_id with list_appointment_groups, or use get_appointment_group with include=["participant_count"] for just a count instead of the full list.
name: list_appointment_group_users
title: List Appointment Group Users
